answers.text: Error executing tool hd_transparent_enable: the syscall-hook technique (evade_mask bit 0x1) hangs the machine in local VMI mode: it EPT-hooks the global syscall entry, and a core then spins in the hypervisor on the next syscalls (bugcheck 0x101). Pass an evade_mask without bit 0x1 (0x1e is every other technique).
